_comment: The progression tiers of the knavesneeds material set, in order.
`materials` is ordered, and that order is the order a tier's materials appear on a
preview sheet. Each entry is a sprite selector in the same form thumbnail.json uses:
'mod_id/tier' for one tier, or a bare name matched against top-level sprite folders.
A material flagged `"vanilla": true` is built from a vanilla Minecraft ingot rather
than from one of ours. Those wear Simply Swords' own art, copied into
common/sprites/simplyswords/ from the mod jar, so a sheet shows the reference the new
materials are pitched against rather than four blank rows. sheetgen.py labels them so
an artist can tell the reference rows from the work.
Copper has no `sprites` because no copper weapon art exists: Simply Swords ships
iron, gold, diamond and netherite, and its only copper texture is a single longsword
in the MythicMetals compat set. It is listed anyway, and drawn as an empty row, so the
gap is visible instead of silently absent.
This file is read by sheetgen.py only. The generation pipeline in main.py is driven by
tiers.json and does not know about progression tiers.
